## Redesigned Add/Edit Item Modal
- **Wider Layout**: Modified modal width to `w-[650px]` with a 2-column grid representing all fields to match the back office experience.
- **Fields Added / Updated**:
  - **Item Registry Classification**: Toggle buttons for Standard Menu Item vs. Option / Modifier.
  - **Item Name**: Required field.
  - **Short Code / SKU** & **HSN Code**: Positioned side-by-side.
  - **Base Price** & **Initial Stock Qty**: Price maps to base price and is required; stock maps to stock qty.
  - **Menu Category**: Dropdown which gets disabled if "Option / Modifier" is selected.
  - **Food Type**: Dropdown selection (Veg, Non-Veg, Egg).
  - **Tax Product Group** & **Kitchen Department**: Dropdowns populated dynamically from the backend services (`itemMgmtTaxGroups` and `itemMgmtKitchenDepts`).
  - **Product Description**: Full-width textarea.
  - **Active & Recommended Flags**: Side-by-side toggles for "Active / Accept Orders" and "Recommended Item".

## Verification Results
- **Successful Vite Compilation**: Verified that the changes compile cleanly.
- **Visual Accuracy**: Verified layout colors, borders, toggles, dropdowns, and buttons match the premium modern styling of the application.
- **Functionality**: Confirmed all new fields (HSN Code, Tax Product Group, Kitchen Department, Recommended status) save and update correctly via `handleSaveItemMgmt`."
